summary.zh: 搭好带登录、计费和后台的 SaaS 骨架
summary.en: Scaffold a SaaS app with auth, Stripe billing and a dashboard

description.zh: 搭出带登录、数据库、Stripe 订阅计费和后台面板的 SaaS 项目骨架，技术栈为 Next.js App Router、TypeScript、Tailwind、shadcn/ui 和 Drizzle。适合从零启动一个订阅制产品时使用。
description.en: Bootstraps a SaaS app with auth, database, Stripe billing and a dashboard, built on Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui and Drizzle. Use it to start a subscription product from scratch.
